Nature, environment & conservation 1

Explore Thailand's wild landscapes by ear. This first half roams from ภูเขา (mountains) and น้ำตก (waterfalls) to ป่าชายเลน (mangrove forests) and แนวปะการัง (coral reefs), then meets the creatures that live there — ช้างป่า (wild elephants), งูเห่า (cobras), นกเงือก (hornbills) and โลมา (dolphins) — and the idea of a ระบบนิเวศ (ecosystem) where every species has its place. All 30 sentences come with native-speed audio, English translations, and word-by-word notes, so the vocabulary of the natural world sinks in by ear.

The natural world

Hornbills are treated as an indicator of forest health — they need large old trees to nest in, so their presence signals an intact ecosystem. Thai conservation groups run hornbill nest-adoption projects.
